neotv_hero_description: A free, cross-platform online video search and viewing application
neotv_features_items_0: Huge Resource Aggregation: Search movies, TV shows, anime and variety shows from multiple online video sources
neotv_features_items_1: Native Cross-Platform Experience: Built on Tauri 2.0 with near-native performance for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android
neotv_features_items_2: Mobile Optimized: UI deeply optimized for mobile devices, ensuring comfortable operation on phones and tablets
neotv_features_items_3: Douban Content Integration: Browse Douban highly-rated movie and TV recommendations with ranking and genre filtering
neotv_features_items_4: Smart Source Selection: Automatically tests and selects the best playback source with HLS video support
neotv_features_items_5: Open Source & Secure: Fully open source with transparent code, no tracking or advertisements

krkr_hero_description: A native Rust reimplementation of the KiriKiri2 (TVP) engine — pure Rust + Vulkan, running KiriKiri2 games on Linux and Android.
krkr_features_items_0_desc: The upstream C++ TJS2 virtual machine is vendored and driven through a thin Rust FFI wrapper, so unmodified game scripts and save files keep working.
krkr_features_items_1_desc: Archive handling, TLG5/TLG6 image decoding, custom blend modes, font rasterization, Ogg/Opus audio and KAG scenario tags are reimplemented natively in Rust.
krkr_features_items_2_desc: A rendering engine built directly on Vulkan with ash and ash-window. Text is rasterized on the CPU into the layer bitmap.
krkr_features_items_3_desc: FFmpeg on desktop Linux, native MediaCodec on Android. The backend is selected per target, so a desktop backend never leaks into an Android build.
krkr_features_items_4_desc: A native Kotlin / Material 3 launcher using the system file picker, built for arm64-v8a.
krkr_arch_intro: Dependencies point strictly downward. The desktop and Android roots are wiring only — they select the platform and wire the layers together.
krkr_arch_layers_0_desc: TJS VM host — garbage collector, bytecode, script cache
krkr_arch_layers_1_desc: KiriKiri compatibility surface — native classes, KAG, event adapter, plugins
krkr_arch_layers_2_desc: Generic game engine — layer tree, bitmaps, sound mixer, timers, VFS namespace
krkr_arch_layers_3_desc: Stateless services — fs, media, render, windowing, Vulkan, FFmpeg / MediaCodec
krkr_arch_layers_4_desc: Composition root — selects the platform, wires L1 to L4, runs the loop
krkr_build_note: Desktop Linux needs a Vulkan-capable GPU and the FFmpeg development libraries. macOS and iOS are not planned.
krkr_docs_desc: Architecture, module map, rules and the parity reports live in the docs/ tree of the repository.
krkr_footer_notice: krkr-rs is an independent reimplementation and is not affiliated with the original KiriKiri project.
krkr_footer_license: GPL-3.0 (the vendored TJS2 VM keeps its upstream BSD-style license)
